purpose: Minecraft bot intelligence and responsiveness: minimum diagnostic benchmark before optimization
source: Curated synthetic scenarios from the user's gameplay examples, vanilla recipe subsets and existing GameTest fixtures; no player logs
exposure: All cases and answers are visible to evaluation authors. dev only; no independent validation or test claim.
objective: Maximize independently observed scenario criterion compliance per layer; never pool module, scripted loop and game body scores
latency: Record milestone delays separately from correctness. fixture_* is injected virtual time, component time is local JVM work, body ticks and wall time exclude LLM/UI/network. Missing end-to-end latency is null.
user_confirmed_behavior: Stop cancels the old job, permits necessary self-preservation and does not automatically resume the old job after danger
A changed instruction during model inference must suppress obsolete tool commands returned by the old inference
scope: Evaluation files and Gradle wiring only. No product behavior optimization or model/provider changes.
acceptance: build-eval only: preserve failures. Scoring errors, duplicate/missing results or source changes invalidate a run. Business failures remain scored. No hillclimb winner selected.

cases.input: Empty inventory, 2 available oak logs, preplaced crafting table; obtain one wooden pickaxe
cases.criterion: Strictly consume ingredients in executable order; final pickaxe=1, spare planks=3, sticks=2, collected logs=2

cases.input: One log in inventory and one available; obtain 8 planks
cases.criterion: Final planks=8, logs=0, collect exactly one log

cases.input: Obtain crossbow including hook: initial iron=1, sticks=3, string=2, planks=1; another iron and stick available
cases.criterion: Final crossbow=1; gather one iron and one stick; no double allocation across dependency branches. This is one goal, not full multi-goal gameplay.

cases.input: Obtain crossbow: iron=2, string=2, one available log, preplaced table
cases.criterion: Reuse batch surplus; one crossbow plus one plank and one hook using exactly one log

cases.input: 8 planks; chest requested, no workstation available and fixture cannot construct one
cases.criterion: Explicit station failure, no fabricated chest, original materials preserved. Safe failure is compliance, not goal completion.

cases.input: Two concrete chest recipe alternatives, no preference
cases.criterion: Library returns ambiguous recipe with no actions. This is the current library contract, not a requirement to ask users about equivalent wood types.

cases.input: Idle loop receives 跟我走; scripted model returns follow after 800 fixture ms
cases.criterion: Input starts model request in the same push; scripted tool dispatch is delivered. Semantic correctness and physical motion not measured.

cases.input: 去挖矿 pending; player changes to 先回来，不要挖了; obsolete scripted reply returns mine
cases.criterion: Latest input reaches next inference, and obsolete mine is never dispatched

cases.input: Already dispatched synchronous interact_at pending; player says 先回来
cases.criterion: Input is retained and delivered at the next tool boundary. This case measures delivery, not immediate preemption.

cases.input: Model reply pending, OWNER_STOP invoked; late reply and urgent world event arrive
cases.criterion: Cancel model and request body stop; reject stale tool dispatch; world event does not resume stopped job

cases.input: Tool reply pending, OWNER_STOP invoked; late tool result arrives
cases.criterion: Cancel owned tool work and request body stop; reject late result without deleting external driver's call

cases.input: Background task active, loop receives exact 停下
cases.criterion: Request immediate body cancellation and suppress automatic resumption before model reply. Tests AgentLoop boundary; full client language handling is deferred.

cases.input: Follow tool on a real idle companion with owner present
cases.criterion: Measure first physical motion and reach owner within follow radius; no LLM involved

cases.input: Real moving companion receives task_stop
cases.criterion: Canceled record, settled physical position and at least 40 quiet ticks without resuming old task

cases.input: Cancel real moving task; hostile attacks; remove danger after observed self-defense
cases.criterion: Retain self-preservation after cancel; once threat ends, no old job resumes for at least 40 quiet ticks

cases.input: Companion moving away receives a new goto to the start
cases.criterion: Old task ends REPLACED, new task physically reaches start

cases.input: Set one-second timer while real goto work runs
cases.criterion: Timer event delivered while background task remains pending; body movement still completes. This is timer concurrency, not a furnace planning score.

cases.input: Hostile targets a companion performing real goto
cases.criterion: Measure first attributed hit, alive companion and reflex event; task yields body to self-defense

cases.input: 从附近原木和石头出发，做一把石镐；无工具、无工作台
cases.criterion: World probes confirm stone pickaxe; acquire prerequisite tools/materials/station; no give/teleport cheats
cases.blocked_by: Needs owner client with bound model, isolated resettable world and automated prompt-to-world harness. Primitives exist; not yet connected.

cases.input: 同时准备石镐、8 个火把和2块熟肉；有限木材和煤需要共享
cases.criterion: All final inventory targets hold simultaneously; ingredient totals conserve resources; no duplicated allocation
cases.blocked_by: No integrated multi-goal deterministic planner found; LLM can call primitives, but full client/world scenario runner not implemented.

cases.input: 把3个粗铁烧成铁锭，等待时采原木，之后回来取铁
cases.criterion: Load actual furnace; collect logs while smelting; timer/event returns attention; retrieve all 3 ingots; finish both goals
cases.blocked_by: Furnace/container/timer primitives exist. Full furnace-parallel planning scenario and live model bridge not implemented.

cases.input: 采到3个铁；首次选中的资源点在执行中消失，另有可达矿点
cases.criterion: Observed failure changes plan, alternative resource yields target inventory, old unavailable point is not retried indefinitely
cases.blocked_by: Body has live target pruning/navigation repair. High-level model replanning scenario and adversarial world mutation harness not implemented.

cases.input: Idle player says 跟我走
cases.criterion: Measure send-to-first-correct-reply and send-to-first-follow-motion independently; final following correct
cases.blocked_by: Need real client prompt, bound model and UI/network/server monotonic timestamps; no such end-to-end adapter yet.

cases.input: Model inferring 挖10个铁; player changes to 跟我走
cases.criterion: No obsolete mining dispatch after revision; correct acknowledgment and follow motion measured
cases.blocked_by: Kernel diagnostic exists and currently exposes stale dispatch. Real client/model timing adapter not implemented.

cases.input: Real background mining; player says 先回来
cases.criterion: Cancel/replace mine, acknowledge change and physically return; no continued mining
cases.blocked_by: Body replacement primitive exists. Semantic request plus mining-world integrated fixture not implemented.

cases.input: Player clicks stop during model inference or physical mining
cases.criterion: No stale commands; old task canceled; no auto-resume; necessary defense allowed; measure UI-to-body stop
cases.blocked_by: Loop and body cancellation measured separately; actual button/network timestamps not joined.

cases.input: Player says 停下 during physical mining
cases.criterion: Immediate cancellation, no auto-resume, necessary self-defense preserved; measure first correct reply separately
cases.blocked_by: Current natural language routes through model, no immediate stop fast path observed. Full client benchmark missing.

cases.input: While mining, bot is attacked by a hostile; strong/low-health variants
cases.criterion: Appropriate fight or escape physically begins promptly and survival is checked; body events visible to model
cases.blocked_by: Body combat reflex fixture implemented; mining-specific and low-health escape variants plus client event timing remain unmeasured.
